Three accounts raised the same complaint about rotating contacts: Reply Deutschland, valantic AG and Körber Digital.

Reply's is an inbound e-mail from Katrin Sommer dated 18 September 2025. Nothing was raised in October — nobody followed up in October either, and no complaint is logged in October anywhere in the CRM.

So the post-mortem and the record disagree about the date. Treat 18 September as the date the CRM can stand behind.
